thread:
Asha (CS): Quick sync — NovaCloth is expecting a traffic spike Friday 10:00-12:00 PT after a feature drop. Forecast says ~32% above their reserved Dedicated quota. We need a rapid mitigation plan: autoscale guardrail, temporary burst slots, a 20m load validation, and a clear rollback. Volunteers?

Ben (Eng): I can own autoscale + fallback. Suggest scale when p95 > 280ms, max burst +38%. I'll draft a small PR to infra-config.

Rik (Infra): I can provision burst slots but need billing OK for temporary headroom and the quota token. Zone affinity might matter.

Maya (SRE): I'll draft a compact runbook with rollback commands and page matrix. Plan to add a short chaos probe to test fallback model.

Diego (PDE): I'll run a 20-minute soak at 10:15 PT. Load profile: 8k RPS, ~50/50 long/short. Using loadgen: 
```bash
./loadgen --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --rps 8000 --concurrency 160 --duration 1200 \
  --profile profiles/novacloth-mix.json --auth "Bearer $NOVA_TOKEN"
```
I'll capture latency histograms, 5xx rates, and KV cache hits. Will post artifacts here.

ops-bot: Job created -> load-novacloth-1745012450. CI link: https://ci.internal/steps/lt-novacloth-1745012450 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Rik (Infra): Billing looped in. Please confirm quota token and exact ramp window.

Asha (CS): Quota token: NOVA-2026-Q2. Ramp window: Fri 10:00-12:00 PT (setup 09:30). Billing contact: @billing. Renewal team: pause auto-renew flag until we prove ramp. Renewal risk = medium if headroom isn't shown.

Ben (Eng): Draft autoscale snippet I'll PR today:
```yaml
autoscale:
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  scale_up_threshold: 280
  scale_down_threshold: 140
  cool_down: 90s
  max_burst_percent: 38
  fallback_model: gptx-tiny-quant
```
I'll include alert hooks for errors and queue depth.

Maya (SRE): Runbook draft link: https://confluence.internal/novacloth/dedicated-mitigation. Quick rollback commands to add:
```bash
# route back to default pool
redwood route update --customer novacloth --pool default
# disable autoscale for this customer
redwood autoscale update --customer novacloth --enabled false
```
I'll post the chaos probe command later.

Diego (PDE): After staging shadow run I'll upload: latency histograms, sample failing payloads, and KV hit-rate sampler.

Rik (Infra): Provisioned slot ID: provisioned-NOVA-burst-01. Will confirm zone mapping and post invoice flag.

Asha (CS): Owners recap: Ben -> autoscale PR + fallback (EOD today); Rik -> provision slots + slot IDs (EOD today); Diego -> load run Fri 10:15 PT; Maya -> finalize runbook & chaos probe (Thu EOD); Asha -> customer comms + renewal note. Reconvene Thu 15:30 PT for go/no-go.

Ben (Eng): +1 :thumbsup:

Diego (PDE): +1, will post artifacts in thread after the shadow run.

ops-bot: Reminder -> load-novacloth scheduled to start in 24h (job id 1745012450).

Asha (CS): Final ask: log anomalies to ticket NOVA-2100 and escalate to #incidents if 5xx spikes or p95 breaches SLA.
